hook: AI gave me a 6-paragraph essay when I needed a one-line answer. Again.
caption:
AI gave me a 6-paragraph essay when I needed a one-line answer. Again.

Here's what's actually happening:

AI defaults to thoroughness because it doesn't know you.

It doesn't know that you're a "give me the headline, I'll ask follow-ups" person.

It doesn't know that you process information better in bullet points than in flowing prose.

It doesn't know that you're already 80% of the way to the answer and you just need the last 20%.

So it over-explains. Every time. To everyone.

The fix isn't writing a longer prompt. It's not saying "be concise" at the start of every single chat (you shouldn't have to do that).

The fix is AI that already knows you're a bottom-line-first thinker before you type a single word.

That's what a BootFile does — it captures your thinking style once, then every AI response you get is calibrated to how YOUR brain actually works.

No more essays when you wanted a sentence.

Link in bio to build yours.
